queries_run: Airbnb AI agents ChatGPT travel booking disruption threat 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：Airbnb 使用第三方授權的 AI/ML 技術，其規模化採用取決於第三方軟體、基礎設施或 AI 模型的取得，公司無法控制其品質、可得性與定價；若不可用或條款不利，產品吸引力可能下降。
findings.excerpt: In addition to our proprietary technologies, we use AI and ML Technologies licensed from third parties. Our ability to continue to adopt, integrate, and use such technologies at the scale we may need may be dependent on access to specific third-party software, and infrastructure, such as processing hardware or third-party AI models, and we cannot control the quality, availability, or pricing of such third-party software and infrastructure, especially in a highly competitive environment.

clues.claim: Skift：Chesky 稱 ChatGPT 可作為旅遊分銷管道，但要完全繞過 OTA 『非常困難』。
clues.source: Skift - Airbnb's Brian Chesky: ChatGPT Can Distribute Travel, But Cutting Out OTAs Is 'Very Difficult'

clues.claim: Skift 引 Bernstein：Airbnb 在 OTA 中最有條件應對 AI 衝擊，因直接流量占比高。
clues.source: Skift - Airbnb Is the 'Best-Placed' Online Travel Agency to Fend Off AI Disruption: Bernstein Report

substitute_technology.note: 僅1次搜尋；其餘3次未用。搜尋摘要為轉述，無逐字原文，故以 clues 交程式核實。
